data.name: Anywhere RPG
data.detailed_description:
Play any character, in any world*

Anywhere RPG is a real-time, top-down 2D sandbox RPG where an AI director acts as your personal game master. You don't pick from a menu of actions. You type whatever you want to do, like "pickpocket the merchant," "convince the guard I'm the king's cousin," or "attack the bandit." The AI decides whether it's plausible, rolls the dice, narrates what happens and changes the world to match. Nothing is scripted. Everything is generated and resolved live as you play.

Describe any setting, such as a medieval village, a haunted space station or a noir detective city, and the game builds an explorable world around it. You get regions, buildings, items, quests, and NPCs with their own personalities and daily routines.

  • Emergent gameplay: AI-run events, quests that adapt to what you do, and survival stats that fit your setting.

  • Progression: skills generated for your world, perk trees, active abilities and hotkeyed free-text macros.

  • Play your way: endless sandbox, pause anytime, god-mode editor, and every AI prompt is moddable.

About the optional subscription

The game plays fully out of the box on its free AI service, with no setup and no extra cost. The free service will always be supported, and the subscription will never get in its way. If you want more, an optional monthly plan adds a larger AI memory, better text and image models, and more map generations per day.

*Censorship Notice (read before you buy)

In order to comply with Steam's policies, the following types of content are blocked by content moderation and unavailable in the game. Restrictions may be lifted in the future if Steam changes their AI policies:

  • Sexual content

  • Copyrighted material

  • Real-world politics

Please report false positives by filing a bug report from within the game.
